g.title: Customer, owner, cron and provider entry points.
Inventory records every exported method from all 86 route files; catchalls have an additional explicit branch inventory.
Auth, origin, rate limits, validation and response conventions vary by endpoint.
Imported service symbols and source file evidence are retained per operation.
Use the inventory and per-operation graph to inspect the full source-derived lifecycle.
Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.
Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.
